diagnostic.help: refine a transition the net declares
diagnostic.message: refine shop.[ship] by courier: net shop has no transition [ship]

source.text:
composition refined_order_unknown_transition

use "order_flow.petrinet" as shop
use "courier.petrinet" as courier
wire shop.(sending) -> courier.(pickup)
wire courier.(dropped) -> shop.(delivered)
refine shop.[ship] by courier
